evidence.summary: Brady was an offensive assistant on Sean Payton's Saints staff in 2017-18 while Carmichael was offensive coordinator; Brady calls Carmichael one of his mentors from New Orleans.

Reports the Bills hiring Carmichael as OC; he ran the Saints offense for Payton (OC 2009-23) after joining New Orleans in 2006, overlapped with Brady there in 2017-18, and spent two years as a senior assistant on Payton's Broncos staff.
Leonhard leaves Denver for the Bills DC job; he began his NFL coaching career with the Broncos in 2024 as DB coach and pass game coordinator after Wisconsin (2016-22).
Leonhard spent 2024-25 with Sean Payton's Broncos, working under DC Vance Joseph as DB coach/pass game coordinator and then assistant head coach in 2025.
Miami hires Hafley as head coach; he coached the 49ers defensive backs in 2016-18 after two years in Cleveland and was Packers defensive coordinator from 2024 after leaving Boston College.
Tracker of Kyle Shanahan's first 49ers staff: Robert Saleh defensive coordinator, Jeff Hafley defensive backs coach, DeMeco Ryans defensive quality control.

Matt LaFleur picked Hafley as Packers DC; Hafley brought Sean Duggan from Boston College as a defensive assistant and hired Anthony Campanile as LB coach/run game coordinator, a colleague of over a decade.
Packers hire Duggan as a defensive assistant; he was Hafley's linebackers coach at Boston College from 2020 and co-defensive coordinator in 2023.
Duggan becomes Miami DC; he followed Hafley from Ohio State to Boston College and was a linebackers coach under Hafley when Hafley was Green Bay's DC.

Miami promotes Slowik to OC; he spent six seasons on Shanahan's 49ers staff (rising to pass game coordinator in 2022), was Texans OC 2023-24 under DeMeco Ryans, and Dolphins senior pass game coordinator in 2025.
Slowik began in 49ers defensive quality control under Shanahan, moved to offense with Mike McDaniel, was fired by Ryans as Texans OC after 2024 and rejoined McDaniel in Miami in 2025.

Patriots make Kuhr full-time DC for 2026; he was on Vrabel's Titans staff 2020-23 (defensive quality control, inside linebackers assistant) and joined Vrabel in New England in 2025 as inside linebackers coach and play caller.
Reports Kuhr's promotion to Patriots DC after a 2025 season as linebackers coach under Vrabel, following four years on Vrabel's Tennessee staff and a 2024 year with the Giants.
Ranks the head coaches from Bill Belichick's coaching tree, including Josh McDaniels, the longtime Patriots offensive coordinator.
Graham joins McCarthy's Steelers as DC after four seasons as Raiders DC, a job he took in 2022 under former Patriots colleague Josh McDaniels; McCarthy had hired him as Packers LB coach in 2018.
Giants lose DC Graham to the Raiders, where he joins new head coach Josh McDaniels, with whom he overlapped in New England.
Ben McAdoo's 2016 Giants staff keeps Steve Spagnuolo as defensive coordinator and adds Patrick Graham as defensive line coach after seven seasons on the Patriots staff.
Lists the completed 2016 Giants staff with Spagnuolo as defensive coordinator and Patrick Graham, previously Patriots linebackers coach, as defensive line coach.
Jets hire Lions DC Glenn as head coach; he coached the Saints defensive backs 2016-20 and was Detroit's DC under Dan Campbell 2021-24.
Covers the Glenn hire, noting his Saints DB coaching years and praise from head coaches Dan Campbell and Sean Payton.
Dennis Allen, Saints DC while Glenn coached the New Orleans secondary for five years, describes their time working together.
Glenn leaves his job as Saints secondary coach under Payton to become Dan Campbell's defensive coordinator in Detroit.
Jets name Duker DC; he rose on the Lions staff 2021-23 (defensive assistant, safeties, DBs coach) with Glenn as DC, then spent two seasons as Miami's pass game coordinator/secondary coach.
Explains the Duker hire as a reunion with Glenn, whom he worked under in Detroit from 2021 to 2023.
Dolphins hire Lions DB coach Duker as secondary coach on new DC Anthony Weaver's staff; the two had overlapped in Cleveland.
Duker arrives from Miami, where he was pass game coordinator and secondary coach as an assistant under DC Anthony Weaver, after rising under Glenn in Detroit.
Ravens hire Minter, who was on John Harbaugh's Baltimore staff 2017-20, then Jim Harbaugh's Michigan DC (2022-23) and Chargers DC (2024-25).
Minter replaces John Harbaugh, under whom he was a Ravens defensive assistant and DB coach 2017-20; he followed Jim Harbaugh from Michigan to the Chargers.
Weaver returns as DC after three seasons (2021-23) on John Harbaugh's staff as DL coach, run game coordinator and assistant head coach, working under Mike Macdonald; he was Miami DC 2024-25.
Mike McDaniel's Dolphins hire Weaver as DC; he spent 2021-23 with the Ravens, who had just lost DC Mike Macdonald to Seattle.
Dolphins hire Weaver, Baltimore's DL coach and assistant head coach 2021-23, as McDaniel's third defensive coordinator.
Doyle was a Saints offensive assistant 2019-22 under Sean Payton, Broncos tight ends coach 2023-24 and Bears OC in 2025 before Minter hired him.
Bears hire Doyle as OC; he began with the Saints in 2019 as an offensive assistant and followed Payton to Denver in 2023 as tight ends coach.
Assesses the Bengals' pursuit of Taylor as another hire from Sean McVay's Rams staff, where Taylor was assistant WR coach (2017) and QB coach (2018).
Rams QB coach Taylor finalizing a deal to become Bengals head coach after two seasons on McVay's staff.
Bengals promote Pitcher to OC; he has been Zac Taylor's primary quarterbacks coach since 2020 after joining Cincinnati in 2016.
Reports Pitcher's promotion to OC; Taylor retained him in 2019 as assistant QB coach and made him QB coach in 2020.
Bengals name Golden DC, replacing Lou Anarumo; Golden was Cincinnati's linebackers coach in 2020-21 under Taylor and Anarumo before Notre Dame.
Notre Dame loses DC Golden to the Bengals, where he coached linebackers in 2020 and 2021 on Zac Taylor's staff.
Colts hire Anarumo, Cincinnati's DC for the previous six seasons (2019-24) since Zac Taylor became head coach.
Colts expected to hire Anarumo, the Bengals defensive coordinator from 2019 to 2024 who was let go on January 6.
Anarumo, Bengals DC for all six seasons of Zac Taylor's tenure (2019-24), becomes Shane Steichen's DC in Indianapolis.
Browns hire Monken as head coach after three seasons (2023-25) as offensive coordinator on John Harbaugh's Ravens staff.
Reports Cleveland's hiring of Monken, Baltimore's OC since 2023 under Harbaugh and earlier Browns OC under Freddie Kitchens in 2019.
Switzer, on John Harbaugh's Ravens staff since 2017 in several roles and run game coordinator in 2024-25, joins Monken, whom he worked under in Baltimore 2023-25.
Switzer spent nine seasons with the Ravens and built the run game with OC Todd Monken from 2023 to 2025 as run game coordinator.
Calls Saleh Rutenberg's mentor: Saleh brought him to the 49ers as pass game specialist in 2020 and to the Jets as LB coach (2021-24); he then followed former Jets DC Jeff Ulbrich to Atlanta.
Saleh's Jets hire Rutenberg as linebackers coach after a 2020 season as pass game specialist under Saleh in San Francisco.
Browns hire Rutenberg as DC; formerly Jets linebackers coach, he followed Jeff Ulbrich to Atlanta in 2025 as defensive pass game coordinator.
Saleh's Jets hire 49ers passing game specialist Rutenberg as linebackers coach; the two first worked together in Jacksonville 2014-16.
Official career lists: Angelichio was Packers TE coach 2016-18 under Mike McCarthy and Vikings pass game coordinator/TE coach 2022-25; Graham was Giants DL coach 2016-17 and Raiders DC 2022-25.
Angelichio finalizing the Steelers OC job; he coached McCarthy's Packers tight ends 2016-18 and spent four seasons on Kevin O'Connell's Vikings staff as TE coach and pass game coordinator.
Texans hire 49ers DC Ryans; he was San Francisco's defensive quality control coach in 2017, inside LB coach 2018-20 and DC 2021-22.
Reports the Ryans hire, recounting his rise on Kyle Shanahan's 49ers staff from quality control to linebackers coach to defensive coordinator.
Texans hire Caley, who spent 2024 as Sean McVay's pass game coordinator/TE coach with the Rams after eight seasons with the Patriots.
Patriots TE coach Caley leaves for the same job on McVay's Rams staff after eight seasons in New England.
Patriots promote coaching assistant Caley to tight ends coach on Josh McDaniels' offense, replacing Brian Daboll.
New England promotes Caley to tight ends coach for 2017 after two years as an offensive assistant.
Texans hire Burke as DC on DeMeco Ryans' first staff; he was Cardinals DL coach in 2022 and Dolphins DC 2017-18.
Texans' 2026 staff: Matt Burke in his fourth season as DC under Ryans and Nick Caley back for a second season as OC.
Colts hire Steichen, who spent 2021-22 as offensive coordinator on Nick Sirianni's Eagles staff after rising from Chargers quality control to OC.
AP report on Steichen's hire as Colts coach after two seasons running Sirianni's Philadelphia offense.
Colts to hire Cooter as OC under Steichen; Cooter was Jaguars pass game coordinator in 2022 and worked with Steichen in Philadelphia in 2021.
Jacksonville loses pass game coordinator Cooter to Steichen's Colts; Cooter had been an Eagles offensive consultant in 2021 when Steichen was OC.
Kentucky hires Rams assistant QB coach Coen as OC; he joined McVay's Rams in 2018 as assistant WR coach.
Kentucky rehires Coen after one season (2022) as Rams offensive coordinator under Sean McVay, following his 2018-20 Rams assistant years.
Jaguars hire Udinski, who spent 2022-24 on Kevin O'Connell's Vikings staff (assistant to the HC, assistant QB coach, assistant OC).
Udinski leaves Minnesota, where he worked three seasons for O'Connell, to become Liam Coen's OC.
Jaguars hire Campanile as DC; he was Miami's linebackers coach 2020-23 and in 2024 Packers LB coach/run game coordinator under DC Jeff Hafley.
Mike McDaniel's Dolphins to interview LB coach Campanile, who joined Miami under Brian Flores in 2020 and stayed, for their DC opening.
Michigan LB coach Campanile accepts the Dolphins linebackers coach job on Brian Flores' staff.
